text:
Sam: Quick sync — we need a clear, operational set of rules for SI lead handoffs from marketplace / hardware partners so SDRs and SI PMs know who can claim what. Thoughts?
Priya: Yes. Two big qs: soft-claim TTL and how we treat existing SFDC ownership vs incoming SI claims.
Luca: For TTL, +1 for a 72h soft-claim window (auto-release after) and a 24h hard-claim escalation for white-glove deals. Keeps pipeline flowing. :white_check_mark:
Ava: Also we should tag source in metadata (e.g., mp/aws, hw/partnerX, si-referral) so routing rules are deterministic. If account already has an owner, signal owners before reassigning.
Sam: Proposal draft:
- Tagging: marketplace leads -> source=mp, hardware -> source=hw, SI-referrals -> source=si
- Soft-claim: SI can soft-claim for 72h; other teams see "soft-claimed by <SI>"
- Hard-claim: convert to hard-claim only if opportunity is net-new or > $50k ARR. White-glove > $250k requires Sales Ops approval within 24h.
- Existing owner rule: if SFDC account.owner exists and opp is < $50k, notify owner and deny SI hard-claim.
Priya: That sounds reasonable. We also need a concrete field mapping for ingestion so SI teams can push leads reliably. Example mapping we agreed on:
```
csv columns -> platform fields
lead_email -> contact.email
lead_name -> contact.name
lead_company_id -> account.external_id
partner_tag -> source.tags
estimated_value -> opportunity.estimate_usd
marketplace_sku -> opportunity.marketplace_sku
```
IntegrationsBot: New lead ingested from AWS Marketplace — id=9876, source=aws-marketplace, marketplace_sku=RW-INFER-STD, estimated_value=82000
Jun: Quick Q on splits/comp: where are SI success-fee rules kept? Need to know before we allow hard-claims on co-sell.
Ava: docs: partners/si-compensation-2025 (we'll update with the new thresholds). For now assume standard split: 10% on first $100k of ARR credited to SI, then 5% thereafter unless legal has an exception.
Priya: Edge-case: duplicate ingestion + race for claim. Recommend an idempotent intake + claim webhook with optimistic locking. If claim attempt collides return 409 and current claim owner in body. Example: 
```http
POST /v1/lead_claims
{ "lead_id": "9876", "si_id": "si-42", "claim_type": "soft" }
Response 409 -> { "lead_id": "9876", "claimed_by": "si-13", "claim_expires": "2025-09-20T14:32:00Z" }
```
Sam: Nice. Action items:
- Priya: publish field-mapping doc + sample payload (deadline: Friday).
- Ava: add tagging enforcement to intake pipeline and wire the 72h TTL (deadline: Friday).
- Jun: paste/update comp doc link and confirm fees with Rev Ops (EOD Thurs).
- Luca: prototype claim webhook behavior in staging (ping when ready).
Everyone: if you see any customer-facing exceptions (white-glove or strategic), flag them in the thread with acct id and dollar estimate.
Sam: Thanks all — this should reduce pipeline tug-of-war. :rocket:
